description: Defines the Backend class and its Options struct for distributed communication backends in PyTorch, including error types, support capabilities, and various collective operation methods.

classes.name: Backend
classes.description: Abstract class representing a distributed communication backend with various collective operation methods and configuration options.

classes.name: Backend::Options
classes.description: Struct for backend configuration options, including timeout, backend name, group info, and global ranks.

methods.name: getRank
methods.description: Returns the rank of the backend instance.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size (number of processes) in the backend.

methods.name: getID
methods.description: Returns a unique opaque ID for the backend instance.

methods.name: supportsSplitting
methods.description: Indicates if the backend supports splitting.

methods.name: supportsCoalescing
methods.description: Indicates if the backend supports coalescing.

methods.name: supportsTimeEstimation
methods.description: Indicates if the backend supports time estimation.

methods.name: supportsShrinking
methods.description: Indicates if the backend supports shrinking.

methods.name: shrink
methods.description: Returns a shrunken version of the backend excluding specified ranks.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for the backend.

methods.name: getBackendName
methods.description: Returns the name of the backend.

methods.name: _allgather_base
methods.description: Performs a base allgather operation, to be deprecated.

methods.name: reduce_scatter_tensor_coalesced
methods.description: Performs a coalesced reduce-scatter tensor operation.

methods.name: monitoredBarrier
methods.description: Performs a monitored barrier, only supported by GLOO.

methods.name: setSequenceNumberForGroup
methods.description: Sets a sequence number for the group, currently only for GLOO and NCCL.

methods.name: getSequenceNumberForGroup
methods.description: Gets the current sequence number for the group.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends tensors to a specified rank.

methods.name: recv
methods.description: Receives tensors from a specified rank.

methods.name: registerOnCompletionHook
methods.description: Registers a hook to be called upon work completion.

methods.name: waitForPendingWorks
methods.description: Waits for all pending works to complete.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges back into a full backend from subgroups.

methods.name: eagerConnectSingleDevice
methods.description: Performs eager connection to a device if supported.

methods.name: allocateTensor
methods.description: Allocates a tensor from backend memory pool.

methods.name: supportsTensorAlloc
methods.description: Checks if tensor allocation is supported.
